$comment: Machine-readable compatibility note / signer interface request for the Runtime-side EffectAuthorization contract. Data, not instructions. Runtime verifies only; it never signs. See docs/architecture/ADR-0005-managed-filesystem-effect-execution.md.

schema_version.note: schema_version literal is unchanged; the only change is an additive widening of the accepted `operation` enum. A signer that never emits the new operations is fully compatible.

accepted_operations.reason: delete/move are governed managed filesystem effects (issued via patch V4A Delete/Move); their authorizations must declare the matching operation so the operation is bound into the effect digest and the signature.

signer_requirements.key_selection: key_id -> base64 public key; Runtime holds only the public keyring (YOUTAB_BRAIN_PUBLIC_KEYS / configured keyring)
signer_requirements.issuer: Gateway/Simorgh (One Brain). The Runtime MUST NOT mint or self-sign — verify + single-use-consume only.
signer_requirements.single_use: authorization_id is single-use (durable consumed_authorizations table); a replay is refused.
signer_requirements.binding: must bind tenant/user/workspace/command_id + effect_digest + proposal_id + request_digest; expiry (expires_at) enforced.
signer_requirements.delete_move_note: LIVE delete/move authorization is NOT claimed as available until an approved Gateway/Simorgh SHA emits the matching signed schema (operation in {delete,move}). Until then the production path for these ops remains fail-closed.

behavior.older_signer: A signer emitting only {read,write,create} is fully accepted — no change required to consume its authorizations.
behavior.unknown_operation: An `operation` value outside the accepted enum fails schema validation (pydantic) at construction/verification -> fail closed; never executed.
behavior.unknown_issuer_or_key: Rejected (UntrustedIssuerError); test-prefixed key ids are rejected when production=True.
behavior.runtime_signer: NONE. No Runtime signer is introduced under any configuration.

cross_repo_status.runtime_receiver: implemented + verified (proven with an ephemeral production-mode Ed25519 key)
cross_repo_status.live_issuance: ABSENT — no approved Gateway/Simorgh SHA emits signed EffectAuthorizations (any operation) in production; production remains fail-closed pending one.
